summary.text: Stephen Acorn is an independent write-in candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 137, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a sales consultant who ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Acorn was born in Douglas, Georgia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Columbus State University in 2009.
His career experience includes working as a sales consultant, and as of 2024 he was affiliated with the Greater Columbus Chamber.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Coffee County, Georgia, was the youngest of eight children, and graduated from Columbus State University in 2009 with a bachelor's degree in marketing.
Acorn advanced from the Republican primary for District 137 on May 21, 2024, and lost the November 5, 2024 general election.
In the same survey, he said his campaign priorities were an economic environment in which everyone thrives, legal immigration policy, and school choice.
